description: Adds a slide (batchUpdate createSlide) and returns the new slide's objectId in the reply. Pick the look with either predefined_layout (BLANK, TITLE, TITLE_AND_BODY, SECTION_HEADER, ...) or layout_object_id from list_layouts — not both; with neither the slide copies the layout of the current last slide. insertion_index is the 0-based position (omitted = append at the end). Placeholders inherited from the layout arrive empty — find their object ids via list_slides, then fill them with set_text.

insertion_index.description: 0-based position for the new slide; omitted = append at the end.

layout_object_id.description: A concrete layout's object id from list_layouts (alternative to predefined_layout).

object_id.description: Optional custom object id for the new slide (5-50 chars of [a-zA-Z0-9_-:]).

predefined_layout.description: A predefined layout; the theme's actual layouts may support only a subset.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: add_slide
title: Add a slide
